name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Regional Marketing | Home Services Demand Generation, Local Listings & Reviews, Paid and Email Campaigns
summary: Colorado-based marketer with 15+ years in marketing and B2B SaaS, specializing in local demand generation for home-services businesses. At Solenzo I run marketing for electrical, plumbing, and HVAC companies: Google Business Profile and local listings, review generation, paid search, email sequences, and GA4 reporting. Before that I managed paid media for accounts spending $20K+/month at Level Agency, trained partners on Birdeye's reputation and listings tools, and supported client events and industry conventions at Accelo. Meta Ads certified; Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce certificate.

experience.title: Local Marketing & Demand Generation (Home Services) — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Claim, set up, and optimize Google Business Profile listings (categories, services, photos, posts) as the first deliverable for every home-services client, the foundation of their local lead flow.
Build automated review-generation, appointment, and nurture email sequences across a 20+ workflow system, and write the email, ad, and landing page copy.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam leads and improving click quality, then diagnosed on-site conversion as the remaining bottleneck.
Install GA4 and Google Tag Manager with conversion tracking and UTM conventions, and report results on a regular cadence with specific recommendations.
Wrote and published 18 articles on local SEO, reviews, AI search visibility, and attribution for small-business owners.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated marketing across paid media, inbound, and content for ~3 client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, advising on budget planning and allocation.
Ran LinkedIn ad campaigns with A/B-tested setups and built reporting on ROI, CAC, and conversion KPIs for QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Trained and onboarded 15-20 reseller partners, including home-services and healthcare agencies, on Birdeye's review, reputation, and listings-syndication tools, retaining all but one (~94%).
